name: A Hand in the Making
thesis: Colossal cream RAYGEN behind an oversized SERV0 and lilac RUPE in front, on near-black aubergine. A visual project showcase follows immediately: SERV0 in progress, DAVID, and Monstrosity, before the personal letter and software, makerspace, Outpost, and robotics stories.
interaction: Scrolling gently changes the machine’s angle and the name’s position. A keyboard-accessible panel button reveals SERV0’s internal assembly with a controlled wipe. Projects navigation jumps to three illustrated builds with direct repository links; the Stardance bridge connects to software contributions.
why: Preserves the enormous layered image, typography, and midnight-purple palette Raygen liked in 26. Makes the work clearer with real project images, prominent names, plain descriptions, and an explicit current-build label while keeping the personal letter and community stories.
